meta.name: hunt-source-leak
meta.description: Hunt source code and build artifact leakage — JavaScript source maps (.js.map) reconstructing TypeScript/ES6 source, Swagger/OpenAPI JSON endpoint discovery, .env/.git exposure, webpack chunks with hardcoded secrets, robots.txt/security.txt recon, build-info files, asset-manifest.json API route discovery, .DS_Store file listing. Use at the START of every recon session — these findings often unlock the entire attack surface.

copy.tagline: 发现源码泄露与配置暴露，快速定位攻击面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做渗透测试或红队行动，需要快速发现目标泄露的源码和敏感信息
copy.tagline_en: Discover source code leaks and misconfigurations to quickly map attack surface

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会扫描目标网站，查找源代码泄露，如 .js.map 文件、Swagger/OpenAPI 文档、.env 文件、.git 目录暴露等，并尝试提取其中的敏感信息。
howto.when: 在每次侦察会话开始时，用户要求进行信息收集或安全测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描 example.com 的源代码泄露。
检查 example.com 的 .js.map 文件是否有敏感信息。
查找 example.com 的 Swagger 端点。
say.note: Claude 会尝试发现 OpenAPI 规范文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans target websites for source code leaks such as .js.map files, Swagger/OpenAPI docs, .env files, .git directory exposure, and attempts to extract sensitive information.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of every recon session when the user requests information gathering or security testing.

say_en.text: Scan example.com for source code leaks.
say_en.note: Claude will run checks for .env, .git, Swagger, etc.
Claude will download and analyze JavaScript source maps.
Claude will attempt to discover OpenAPI spec files.
